type.name: CFICode

type.name: LegRefID

type.name: IdPrefix

No FIX equivalent — sequential field IDs per CLAUDE.md 60-72 carve-out.

enum.description: FIX tag 39

validValue.name: OrderAlreadyInPendingStatus

validValue.name: OrigOrdModTime

enum.name: CxlRejResponseToEnum
enum.description: FIX tag 434 — message that the cancel reject is responding to. Tag 434 is FIX int, so SBE values are the wire integers.

enum.name: QuoteRejectReasonEnum
enum.description: FIX tag 658 (QuoteRequestRejectReason) — values 1..5,99. nullValue=255 sentinel for use as optional enum field; producers must explicitly write 255 when leaving the field unset since SBE does not auto-initialise enum bytes.

enum.name: SettlTypeEnum
enum.description: FIX tag 63 — settlement type. Logical ordinals; the FIX-SBE translator maps to/from the FIX char wire values ('0'-'9', 'B', 'C'). nullValue=255 sentinel disambiguates 'unset' from Regular(0) when used as an optional field; producers must explicitly write 255 since SBE does not auto-initialise enum bytes.

validValue.name: BrokenDate
validValue.description: Broken Date — FIX 'B' (FX with non-standard date)

enum.name: ProductTypeEnum
enum.description: Custom FX product classification

enum.name: LegProductEnum
enum.description: FIX tag 607 — leg product / asset class. For FX use Currency(4).

enum.name: TenorEnum

enum.name: AccountStatusEnum

validValue.name: Active
validValue.description: Account is active and can trade

validValue.name: Suspended

enum.name: AccountTypeEnum
enum.description: Account type — distinguishes house, client, and market-maker accounts for risk and reporting

enum.name: AcctIDSourceEnum
enum.description: FIX tag 660 — identifies the scheme of the account identifier so the same account can carry multiple external identifiers

enum.name: ComplianceStatusEnum
enum.description: Compliance / KYC summary status, kept separate from administrative AccountStatusEnum so the cluster can suspend trading on compliance grounds without disturbing operational state

enum.name: CurrencyClassEnum
enum.description: Currency class — distinguishes fiat from metals (XAU/XAG), crypto, and IMF SDR / fund codes. Replaces a simple isFx boolean since 'every fiat is FX' makes that flag redundant.

enum.name: RfqStateEnum
enum.description: RFQ lifecycle state for snapshot serialization (terminal states Filled/Rejected/Expired are not snapshotted)

validValue.name: Quoted
validValue.description: Quote sent to client, awaiting accept

enum.name: BooleanType
enum.description: Boolean encoding for SBE flag fields (FIX-style char 'Y'/'N' is mapped at the FIX-SBE translator boundary)

enum.name: EventTypeEnum
enum.description: Domain event type classifier

enum.name: RejectReasonEnum
enum.description: Domain rejection reason codes — values 1..14. nullValue=255 sentinel for use as optional enum field; producers must explicitly write 255 when leaving the field unset since SBE does not auto-initialise enum bytes.

validValue.name: AccountNoTradePermission
validValue.description: Account does not have trade permission

validValue.name: AccountNoQuotePermission
validValue.description: Account does not have quote permission

validValue.name: DuplicateAccountCode
validValue.description: Duplicate accountCode loaded under a different accountId

validValue.name: UnknownCurrency
validValue.description: Currency code not found in CurrencyStore

validValue.name: InvalidCurrencyCode
validValue.description: Currency code is not 3 ASCII uppercase letters

validValue.name: TradingHalted
validValue.description: Trading globally halted by operator (APP-152 first slice — cluster-side halt primitive; the admin command path lands later)

validValue.name: RateLimitExceeded
validValue.description: Account exceeded its maxOrdersPerSecond rate limit for the current 1-second window (APP-62 slice 2)

validValue.name: DailyVolumeExceeded
validValue.description: Order would push the account's daily admitted-quantity total over its maxDailyVolume limit (APP-62 slice 3 — current implementation tracks ADMITTED qty, not filled; slice 4 follow-up will refine to filled-qty if needed)

enum.name: CancelReasonEnum
enum.description: Reason an order was cancelled (APP-151 phase 3). Drives FIX Text(58) augmentation on the cancel ExecutionReport so the counterparty can distinguish server-initiated cancels (session disconnect, idle timeout, operator force) from counterparty-initiated cancels (explicit FIX 35=F).

validValue.name: ExplicitCancel
validValue.description: Counterparty-initiated FIX OrderCancelRequest (35=F) — APP-65 cancel/replace path will set this when it lands.

validValue.name: SessionDisconnect
validValue.description: Cluster auto-cancelled the order because the FIX session that placed it hard-disconnected — APP-151 phase 1 emitter sets this.

validValue.name: IdleTimeout
validValue.description: Cluster auto-cancelled the order because the session crossed the idle-timeout threshold — APP-151 phase 4 emitter will set this.

validValue.name: OperatorForce
validValue.description: Operator-initiated force-cancel via admin path — APP-153 admin command will set this.

composite.name: varDataEncoding
composite.description: Variable-length binary data encoding. No characterEncoding — token and snapshot payload are raw binary, not strings.

composite.name: uuid
composite.description: RFC 4122 UUID as two int64 halves. Used for WebSocket sessionId and snapshotId.

enum.name: WebSocketErrorCode
enum.description: WebSocket-specific error codes for server-to-browser error frames (template 67)

validValue.name: InvalidSubscription
validValue.description: Symbol not found or max subscriptions exceeded

validValue.name: HeartbeatTimeout
validValue.description: No client heartbeat within timeout period

validValue.name: VersionMismatch
validValue.description: Protocol version not supported by server

validValue.name: CommandRejected
validValue.description: Command failed entitlement or validation check

validValue.name: SnapshotEntityTooLarge
validValue.description: Individual entity exceeds snapshot fragment size

validValue.name: SymbolUnknown
validValue.description: Snapshot request for a symbol not present in the SymbolEntitlementMap (Phase 3 Commit A — session preserved)

validValue.name: EntitlementDenied
validValue.description: Snapshot or subscription request denied by the per-account symbol entitlement guard (Phase 3 Commit A — session preserved)

validValue.name: SnapshotThrottled
validValue.description: Snapshot request rejected by the per-session token-bucket rate limit (Phase 3 Commit A — token NOT consumed on reject)

validValue.name: SnapshotBackpressured
validValue.description: Snapshot request rejected because the Aeron offer to stream 205 returned BACK_PRESSURED / NOT_CONNECTED / ADMIN_ACTION (Phase 3 Commit A — token refunded)

validValue.name: Malformed
validValue.description: Frame rejected as malformed by the dispatcher admission pipeline (bad SBE header, bad length, bad symbol encoding) — session torn down by RFC 6455 close 1003

validValue.name: AuthExpiringSoon
validValue.description: JWT is within the soft-expiry window — client should reauth in-session via a fresh token (template 60 again) BEFORE the hard expiry forces a SessionExpired close. Session preserved; informational only (Phase 3 Commit B).

enum.name: CommandAckStatus
enum.description: Status of a browser command acknowledgement (template 70)

validValue.name: Accepted
validValue.description: Command accepted and forwarded to cluster

validValue.name: Rejected
validValue.description: Command failed validation or entitlement check

validValue.name: Duplicate
validValue.description: ClOrdID already seen in dedup cache

enum.name: FeedStateEnum
enum.description: Market-data feed liveness state machine — emitted on MarketDataFeedStateChange (template 57). LIVE: most recent inbound fragment was a tick (template 54) within MARKET_DATA_HEARTBEAT_BASE_MS × 1.5. QUIET: only heartbeats (template 55) have arrived within the live window — publisher up but no ticks for any subscribed symbol. STALE: no fragment of any kind for MARKET_DATA_STALE_THRESHOLD_NANOS (3 s = 3 × heartbeat). EBS Direct / ICE Impact pattern: heartbeats alone do NOT clear STALE — only a real tick proves the price path is healthy.

validValue.name: Live
validValue.description: Ticks flowing within the live window

validValue.name: Stale
validValue.description: No fragments observed for the stale threshold

sbe:message.name: QuoteRequest
sbe:message.description: Request for quote from client (single-leg or swap)

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Swap legs — 0 for single-leg, 2 for swap (near + far)

sbe:message.name: Quote
sbe:message.description: Quote response to client (single-leg or swap)

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

field.name: validUntil
field.description: ValidUntilTime — quote expiry epoch nanos. Set from cluster ts + RFQ TTL.

field.name: swapPoints
field.description: Custom: far price - near price, fixed-point 10^-8 (swap only)

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Swap legs — 0 for single-leg, 2 for swap (near + far)

sbe:message.name: QuoteRequestReject
sbe:message.description: Quote request rejection

field.name: quoteRejectReason
field.description: FIX tag 658 (QuoteRequestRejectReason). SBE enum values match the FIX tag 658 value set.

sbe:message.name: NewOrderSingle
sbe:message.description: New single-leg order, or AcceptQuote (ordType=PreviouslyQuoted, quoteId set). For FX swaps and other multileg orders use NewOrderMultileg (35=AB) instead.

field.name: quoteId
field.description: Reference to accepted quote (empty if not from RFQ)

field.name: price
field.description: Order price, fixed-point 10^-8 (null for market orders)

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

sbe:message.name: NewOrderMultileg
sbe:message.description: New multileg order. Top-level fields describe the package; per-leg fields go in the noLegs group. Use for FX swaps (productType=Swap) and any other multi-leg structure (cross-currency, NDF rolls, etc.).

field.name: quoteId
field.description: Reference to accepted quote (empty if not from RFQ)

field.name: symbol
field.description: Top-level pair (legs may differ for cross-currency swaps)

field.name: side
field.description: Side of the package (per-leg side overrides via legSide)

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Multileg legs (typically 2 for an FX swap: near + far, opposite sides)

field.name: legSymbol
field.description: Per-leg symbol — may differ from parent for cross-currency swaps

field.name: legCFICode
field.description: ISO 10962 CFI code (typically MRCXXX for FX)

field.name: legMaturityDate
field.description: ISO date YYYYMMDD; reuses SettlDate type

field.name: legRatioQty
field.description: Leg ratio relative to package, fixed-point 10^-8

sbe:message.name: MultilegOrderCancelReplace
sbe:message.description: Cancel/replace for a multileg order placed via NewOrderMultileg (35=AB). Mirrors NewOrderMultileg with origClOrdId/orderId added so the engine can locate the original package.

field.name: origClOrdId
field.description: ClOrdId of the order to replace

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Replacement legs — full set, even unchanged ones (FIX semantics)

field.name: legRatioQty
field.description: Leg ratio relative to package, fixed-point 10^-8

sbe:message.name: ExecutionReport
sbe:message.description: Execution report for order status updates (single-leg or swap)

field.name: quoteId
field.description: Echoed if order originated from RFQ

field.name: avgPx
field.description: Average fill price, fixed-point 10^-8 (null if no fills)

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Swap legs — 0 for single-leg, 2 for swap (near + far)

field.name: legLastQty
field.description: Custom: leg fill quantity, fixed-point 10^-8 (FIX 5.0 SP2 has tag 1418 LegLastQty; not adopted — schema is FIX 4.4)

field.name: legCumQty
field.description: Custom: leg cumulative filled quantity, fixed-point 10^-8

sbe:message.name: CancelOrderRequest
sbe:message.description: Order cancel request

field.name: origClOrdId
field.description: ClOrdId of the order to cancel

field.name: clOrdId
field.description: New clOrdId for this cancel request

sbe:message.name: MassQuote
sbe:message.description: Mass quote with multiple quote entries

group.name: noQuoteEntries
group.description: Repeating group of quote entries

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

sbe:message.name: OrderCancelReject
sbe:message.description: Reject for OrderCancelRequest (35=F) or OrderCancelReplaceRequest (35=G). Distinct from a generic order rejection so the counterparty can tell 'cancel failed' apart from 'order rejected'.

field.name: orderId
field.description: Original order id, or 'NONE' if unknown

field.name: clOrdId
field.description: ClOrdId of the failed cancel/replace request

field.name: origClOrdId
field.description: ClOrdId of the order the cancel was targeting

field.name: ordStatus
field.description: Current order status (or Rejected if unknown)

sbe:message.name: LoadAccount
sbe:message.description: Load (or reload) one account into the cluster's AccountStore. Internal command — no FIX MsgType.

field.name: parentAccountId
field.description: Parent account id for give-up arrangements (FIX 453 NoPartyIDs flow); 0 = no parent

field.name: acctIdSource
field.description: FIX tag 660 — scheme of the external code (Internal/BIC/SID/…)

field.name: baseCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 base currency; must exist in CurrencyStore

field.name: complianceStatus
field.description: Compliance / KYC summary; separate from administrative status

field.name: capabilities
field.description: Capabilities bitfield: bit 0 = CAN_TRADE, bit 1 = CAN_RFQ, bits 2..63 reserved for future capabilities (CAN_SHORT, CAN_MARGIN, …)

sbe:message.name: LoadAccountBatch
sbe:message.description: Bulk load N accounts in one consensus round-trip. Used at start-of-day to load 10k–50k client accounts without thrashing the replicated log.

field.name: transactTime
field.description: Epoch nanos for the whole batch

group.name: noAccounts
group.description: One entry per account in the batch

sbe:message.name: LoadCurrency
sbe:message.description: Load (or reload) one ISO 4217 currency into the cluster's CurrencyStore. Identity + decimals + class only — pip and settlement days live on a future CurrencyPairStore since they are per-pair, not per-currency.

field.name: ccyCode
field.description: ISO 4217 alpha-3 code (FIX tag 15), uppercase ASCII; primary key

sbe:message.name: LoadCurrencyBatch
sbe:message.description: Bulk load N currencies in one consensus round-trip.

group.name: noCurrencies
group.description: One entry per currency in the batch

sbe:message.name: LoadRiskLimit
sbe:message.description: Load (or reload) one risk-limit record into the cluster's RiskLimitStore. accountId must already exist in AccountStore. Flat per-account limits in this PR; hierarchical (firm/desk/trader) is a follow-up.

field.name: maxOrderNotional
field.description: Max single-order notional value (price × qty), fixed-point 10^-8 (0 = unlimited)

field.name: maxDailyVolume
field.description: Max daily aggregate quantity, fixed-point 10^-8 (0 = unlimited)

field.name: maxDailyLossBps
field.description: Max intraday loss in basis points (0 = unlimited)

field.name: maxOrdersPerSecond
field.description: Max NewOrderSingle admissions per 1-second window per account (0 = unlimited) — APP-62 slice 2

sbe:message.name: LoadRiskLimitBatch
sbe:message.description: Bulk load N risk-limit records in one consensus round-trip.

group.name: noRiskLimits
group.description: One entry per risk-limit record in the batch

sbe:message.name: HaltTradingCommand
sbe:message.description: Admin command: set the cluster-wide trading-halt flag to true. While set, NewOrderSingleHandler rejects every NOS with RejectReasonEnum.TradingHalted before any other validation. Idempotent — issuing while already halted is a no-op for state but still emits an audit event.

field.name: reason
field.description: Free-text reason (audit-only — e.g., 'Market-data feed degraded, halting trading')

field.name: transactTime
field.description: Caller's epoch nanos (advisory only — cluster restamps with its own timestamp on emit)

sbe:message.name: ResumeTradingCommand
sbe:message.description: Admin command: clear the cluster-wide trading-halt flag (resume admitting new orders). Idempotent — issuing while already resumed is a no-op for state but still emits an audit event.

field.name: reason
field.description: Free-text reason (audit-only — e.g., 'Feed restored, resuming trading')

field.name: transactTime
field.description: Caller's epoch nanos (advisory only — cluster restamps with its own timestamp on emit)

sbe:message.name: PriceRequest
sbe:message.description: Internal: cluster asks pricing service to price an RFQ. Carries the full FX context (productType, settlement, currency, tenor) so the pricing service can price spots, forwards, and swaps without consulting the cluster again.

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Swap legs (empty for single-leg). Mirrors QuoteRequest.noLegs so the pricing service can price both legs of a swap.

sbe:message.name: PriceResponse
sbe:message.description: Internal: pricing service returns a quote (or declines via accepted=False)

field.name: validUntil
field.description: Quote expiry, epoch nanos (null when accepted=False)

field.name: accepted
field.description: True if pricing service produced a quote; False = decline (e.g., unsupported symbol, market closed)

field.name: quoteRejectReason
field.description: FIX tag 658 (QuoteRequestRejectReason). Structured decline reason when accepted=False

field.name: text
field.description: Explanation when accepted=False; empty when accepted=True

field.name: swapPoints
field.description: Custom: far price - near price for swap pricing, fixed-point 10^-8

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Per-leg pricing for swap quotes (empty for single-leg). Mirrors PriceReceivedEvent.noLegs and Quote.noLegs so the cluster can construct the outbound Quote without re-deriving leg prices.

sbe:message.name: PriceValidationRequest
sbe:message.description: Internal: cluster asks pricing service to validate an inbound order's price (e.g., AcceptQuote). Carries the full order context — account, FX product context (productType, settlDate/Type, currency pair, tenor), and per-leg detail — so the pricer can apply account-specific tiering and leg-level checks for swaps.

field.name: quoteReqId
field.description: Original PriceRequest identifier — the pricing service keys stored quotes by quoteReqId, so the orchestrator must forward it here for validation lookup.

field.name: price
field.description: Order price to validate, fixed-point 10^-8 (null for market orders — mirrors NewOrderSingle/NewOrderMultileg)

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Swap legs (empty for single-leg). Full FX leg context — mirrors PriceRequest.noLegs plus the legPrice that validation needs.

field.name: legPrice
field.description: Leg order price, fixed-point 10^-8 (null for market legs — symmetry with parent price)

sbe:message.name: PriceValidationResponse
sbe:message.description: Internal: pricing service confirms (or rejects) an order price. The structured `reason` field lets the cluster emit a specific OrderRejectedEvent reason code on validation failure rather than a generic reject.

field.name: valid
field.description: True if the order price is acceptable to the pricing service

field.name: text
field.description: Free-text rejection reason when valid=False; empty when valid=True

sbe:message.name: MarketDataTick
sbe:message.description: Best-effort top-of-book tick. Conflated 5 ms cadence at publisher. Per-symbol monotonic symbolSeq (FIX RptSeq tag 83) for gap detection. Snapshot frames carry symbolSeq=0 (sentinel); next live tick resumes from 1.

field.name: symbolSeq
field.description: Per-symbol monotonic publish sequence (FIX RptSeq tag 83). int64 (NOT uint64) for Java codec interop; wrap handled via Long.compareUnsigned. symbolSeq=0 is the snapshot sentinel.

field.name: ingressNanos
field.description: Epoch-nanos when the synthetic adapter sampled the mid-rate (FIX TransactTime tag 60 semantics; binary int64 form NOT UTCTimestamp string).

field.name: serverNanos
field.description: Epoch-nanos when the publisher began SBE encode (FIX SendingTime tag 52 semantics; binary int64 form).

sbe:message.name: MarketDataHeartbeat
sbe:message.description: Best-effort heartbeat at MARKET_DATA_HEARTBEAT_BASE_MS ± 10% jitter (XorShift64-seeded per-process for anti-thundering-herd). Carries per-symbol lastPublishedSeq so the browser can compute publisher-conflated-drop vs network-drop attribution (CME MDP 3.0 gap-detection pattern).

field.name: serverNanos
field.description: Epoch-nanos when the publisher emitted this heartbeat (FIX SendingTime tag 52 semantics).

group.name: lastPublishedSeq
group.description: Per-symbol most-recent published symbolSeq. Empty on first heartbeat before any tick; one entry per symbol the publisher has ever published. Browser uses (publisher_lastPublishedSeq - browser_lastReceivedSeq - in_flight) to attribute publisher-conflated drops vs network drops.

field.name: seq
field.description: Most recently published symbolSeq for this symbol (FIX RptSeq tag 83). int64 NOT uint64 — Java codec interop; wrap via Long.compareUnsigned.

sbe:message.name: MarketDataSnapshotRequest
sbe:message.description: Browser-to-publisher (via ws-server) request for the cached top-of-book for one symbol. ws-server admission pipeline: malformed-payload guard → entitlement check → token-bucket consume (10/sec/session) → per-symbol dedup within drain cycle → Aeron stream-205 offer with five-case return-code handling. Publisher responds by re-emitting the cached MarketDataTick with symbolSeq=0 (snapshot sentinel).

field.name: symbol
field.description: Instrument symbol whose top-of-book snapshot is requested (FIX tag 55)

sbe:message.name: MarketDataFeedStateChange
sbe:message.description: Reliable feed-liveness state transition emitted by MarketDataSubscriptionLivenessTracker on every LIVE/QUIET/STALE transition. EBS Direct / ICE Impact pattern: heartbeats alone cannot clear STALE — only a real tick proves the price path is healthy. Routed via the reliable egress queue (BIT_PRICES subscribers).

field.name: state
field.description: New feed state (carve-out: no FIX equivalent; sequential id=1 permitted per CLAUDE.md 54-59 carve-out)

field.name: serverNanos
field.description: Epoch-nanos when the liveness tracker observed the transition (FIX SendingTime tag 52 semantics)

sbe:message.name: WebSocketAuth
sbe:message.description: Browser-to-server: JWT authentication after WebSocket upgrade. Must be the first binary frame sent.

field.name: protocolVersion
field.description: Client protocol version for compatibility negotiation

data.name: token
data.description: JWT token bytes (RS256 signed). Raw binary, not a Java String.

sbe:message.name: WebSocketAuthAck
sbe:message.description: Server-to-browser: authentication accepted, session assigned. Extended in Phase 3 with per-account symbolPreferences and panelLayout repeating groups (additive only; pre-prod schema is pinned at version=1 / semanticVersion=0.1.0).

field.name: sessionId
field.description: Assigned session UUID (UUID.randomUUID — acceptable outside cluster)

field.name: protocolVersion
field.description: Server-asserted protocol version constant. Server hard-codes EXPECTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION (=1); never echoes a client-supplied value. Client compares the decoded value against its own EXPECTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION constant — anti-echo defense per APP-36 §2.5.

field.name: serverHeartbeatIntervalMs
field.description: Negotiated server-→client WebSocketHeartbeat (template 64) cadence in ms; 0 → client uses 5000ms default per APP-36 §2.8

field.name: clientHeartbeatIntervalMs
field.description: Negotiated client-→server ClientHeartbeat (template 65) cadence in ms; 0 → client uses 10000ms default; server hard-disconnect at 2× this value

group.name: symbolPreferences
group.description: Per-account default symbol cohort. Sourced from reference-data AccountRecord.symbolPreferences. Empty → worker falls back to DEFAULT_SUBSCRIBE_SYMBOLS. Worker subscribes to the union of this list ∪ defaults.

field.name: symbol
field.description: Instrument symbol (FIX tag 55); validated against ^[A-Z]{6,8}$ at YAML load

group.name: panelLayout
group.description: Per-account UI panel-to-slot mapping. Sourced from reference-data AccountRecord.panelLayout. Empty → App.tsx uses the default slot (right-top for OrderEntryForm). Production-path field (NOT an observer-hook); ships in the prod bundle.

field.name: panelId
field.description: Panel identifier (e.g., 'order-entry'=11 chars, 'positions'=9 chars); PanelString char[16] — sized to accommodate the longest expected production value. Sequential field id permitted per CLAUDE.md 60-72 carve-out (no FIX equivalent).

field.name: slot
field.description: Slot identifier (e.g., 'right-top'=9 chars, 'right-bottom'=12 chars, 'left-middle'=11 chars); PanelString char[16].

sbe:message.name: WebSocketSubscribe
sbe:message.description: Browser-to-server: subscribe to symbols. Max 100 symbols enforced server-side.

group.name: symbols
group.description: Subscription entries — each specifies a symbol and bitmask of desired event types

field.name: eventTypes
field.description: Bitmask of desired event categories. Bit positions are compact server-defined flags (NOT EventTypeEnum ordinals). bit 0=order lifecycle (Created/Rejected/Filled/Canceled, templates 100-103), bit 1=positions (template 204), bit 2=prices (template 51), bit 3=quotes (QuoteRequested/Created/Rejected/Expired, templates 104-107), bit 4=account events (templates 110-111). SubscriptionFilter maps these flags to actual templateIds. Value 0xFFFFFFFF = subscribe to all.

sbe:message.name: WebSocketUnsubscribe
sbe:message.description: Browser-to-server: unsubscribe from symbols. Unsubscribe is not rate-limited.

group.name: symbols
group.description: Symbols to remove from subscription set

sbe:message.name: WebSocketHeartbeat
sbe:message.description: Server-to-browser: heartbeat with wall-clock timestamp. Best-effort stream (no sequence number). Sent every 5 seconds.

field.name: serverNanos
field.description: EpochNanoClock wall-clock timestamp in nanoseconds. NOT a cluster timestamp.

sbe:message.name: ClientHeartbeat
sbe:message.description: Browser-to-server: heartbeat. Expected every 10 seconds. Server disconnects after 20s timeout (one missed heartbeat tolerated).

sbe:message.name: WebSocketSnapshot
sbe:message.description: Server-to-browser: fragmented snapshot containing current-state SBE entities (templates 201-204). Individual entities are never split across fragments.

field.name: snapshotId
field.description: Snapshot correlation UUID — all fragments share this ID

field.name: totalFragments
field.description: Total fragment count for this snapshot

data.name: payload
data.description: Packed SBE entities using cluster snapshot templates (201=Account, 202=OrderBook, 204=Position). Max 16KB per fragment.

sbe:message.name: WebSocketError
sbe:message.description: Server-to-browser: error notification. errorText restricted to predefined strings per WebSocketErrorCode enum — no free-form text.

data.name: errorText
data.description: Predefined error string from ErrorTextRegistry. No stack traces or dynamic content.

sbe:message.name: WebSocketGapRequest
sbe:message.description: Browser-to-server: request replay of missed reliable messages. Server pauses live delivery, replays gap with replay flag, sends ReplayComplete, resumes live.

sbe:message.name: SessionResume
sbe:message.description: Browser-to-server: reconnect to existing session within 30s grace period. Requires fresh JWT. jti-to-sessionId binding verified to prevent session hijacking.

field.name: lastSeqNo
field.description: Last received reliable sequence number — server replays from here

sbe:message.name: CommandAck
sbe:message.description: Server-to-browser: acknowledges a browser command (NOS, Cancel, QuoteReq). Reliable stream.

field.name: clientCmdSeqNo
field.description: Client-assigned command sequence number (must be monotonically increasing per session)

field.name: status
field.description: Whether the command was accepted, rejected, duplicate, or throttled

sbe:message.name: ClientAck
sbe:message.description: Browser-to-server: acknowledge highest received reliable seqNo. Sent every 100 reliable messages OR every 1 second (whichever first). Used for slow consumer detection.

field.name: lastReceivedSeqNo
field.description: Highest reliable sequence number processed by client

sbe:message.name: ReplayComplete
sbe:message.description: Server-to-browser: marker indicating gap replay is finished. Live delivery resumes after this frame. Empty body (header only).

sbe:message.name: OrderCreatedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when a new order is accepted into the order book

field.name: execId
field.description: Execution identifier for the New acknowledgement

field.name: price
field.description: Order price, fixed-point 10^-8 (null for market orders)

field.name: quoteId
field.description: Reference to accepted quote; empty bytes if not from RFQ

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

sbe:message.name: OrderRejectedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when a new order is rejected

field.name: currency
field.description: Order currency for gateway FIX translation

sbe:message.name: OrderFilledEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when an order is partially or fully filled

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Swap legs — 0 for single-leg, 2 for swap (near + far)

field.name: legLastQty
field.description: Custom: leg fill quantity, fixed-point 10^-8 (FIX 5.0 SP2 has tag 1418 LegLastQty; not adopted — schema is FIX 4.4)

field.name: legCumQty
field.description: Custom: leg cumulative filled quantity, fixed-point 10^-8

sbe:message.name: OrderCanceledEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when an order is canceled. Carries the full set of fields the gateway needs to synthesise a FIX 4.4 ExecutionReport (35=8) with ExecType=Canceled.

field.name: execId
field.description: Engine-generated execution id for this cancel event (FIX tag 17). Unique per ExecType per day per FIX 4.4 §4.4.5. Generated via the same id-generator as OrderCreatedEvent so the gateway no longer needs to synthesise a 'CXL-'-prefixed sentinel.

field.name: cumQty
field.description: Cumulative filled quantity at cancel time, fixed-point 10^-8. 0 for the common phase-1 case (session-disconnect cancel of unfilled orders); non-zero only when phase 4+ work allows cancel of partially-filled orders.

field.name: cancelReason
field.description: Why the cancel was triggered. APP-151 phase 1 session-disconnect emitter sets SessionDisconnect; phases 3-4 + future tickets set the other values.

sbe:message.name: QuoteRequestedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when a quote request is received from a client

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Swap legs — 0 for single-leg, 2 for swap (near + far)

sbe:message.name: QuoteCreatedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when a quote is created and sent to the client

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

field.name: swapPoints
field.description: Custom: far price - near price, fixed-point 10^-8 (swap only)

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Swap legs — 0 for single-leg, 2 for swap (near + far)

field.name: legTenor
field.description: Leg tenor — propagated from QuoteRequestedEvent for downstream identity / audit

field.name: legOrderQty
field.description: Leg quantity, fixed-point 10^-8 — propagated from QuoteRequestedEvent

sbe:message.name: QuoteRejectedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when a quote request is rejected

sbe:message.name: QuoteExpiredEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when a quote expires without being accepted

sbe:message.name: PriceRequestedEvent
sbe:message.description: Internal event: price request sent to pricing service

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Swap legs — 0 for single-leg, 2 for swap (near + far)

sbe:message.name: PriceReceivedEvent
sbe:message.description: Internal event: price received from pricing service

field.name: swapPoints
field.description: Custom: far price - near price, fixed-point 10^-8 (swap only)

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Swap legs — 0 for single-leg, 2 for swap (near + far)

sbe:message.name: AccountLoadedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when an account is loaded into AccountStore. Mirrors LoadAccount field set.

sbe:message.name: AccountLoadRejectedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when an account load is rejected

sbe:message.name: OrderCancelRejectedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when a CancelOrderRequest fails (order not found, already filled, etc.). Distinct from OrderRejectedEvent which is for failed NEW orders.

field.name: orderId
field.description: Original order id, or 'NONE' if unknown

field.name: clOrdId
field.description: ClOrdId of the failed cancel/replace request

field.name: origClOrdId
field.description: ClOrdId of the order the cancel was targeting

sbe:message.name: CurrencyLoadedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when a currency is loaded into CurrencyStore.

sbe:message.name: CurrencyLoadRejectedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when a currency load is rejected (validation or duplicate).

sbe:message.name: RiskLimitLoadedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when a risk-limit record is loaded into RiskLimitStore.

sbe:message.name: RiskLimitLoadRejectedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when a risk-limit load is rejected (FK violation, negative limit, …).

sbe:message.name: TradingHaltActivatedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when the trading-halt circuit breaker transitions from cleared to halted via HaltTradingCommand (template 17). Audit trail event — every halt attempt produces one event even if the flag was already set, so the operator log captures intent and timing precisely.

field.name: adminSessionId
field.description: Aeron Cluster ClientSession id of the admin that issued the command

field.name: previouslyHalted
field.description: 1 if the flag was already set when the command arrived (no-op for state, still emitted for audit), 0 otherwise

field.name: reason
field.description: Free-text reason supplied by the admin

sbe:message.name: TradingHaltClearedEvent
sbe:message.description: Emitted when the trading-halt circuit breaker transitions from halted to cleared via ResumeTradingCommand (template 18). Mirror of TradingHaltActivatedEvent (117). Audit trail event — every resume attempt produces one event even if the flag was already cleared.

field.name: adminSessionId
field.description: Aeron Cluster ClientSession id of the admin that issued the command

field.name: previouslyHalted
field.description: 1 if the flag was set when the command arrived (state cleared), 0 if it was already cleared (no-op for state)

field.name: reason
field.description: Free-text reason supplied by the admin

sbe:message.name: SnapshotTaken
sbe:message.description: Snapshot marker written at the start of each snapshot. The store-count, total byte length, and checksum cover the subsequent *Snapshot messages and let the loader detect truncation or corruption.

field.name: lastSequenceNumber
field.description: Last event sequence number included in snapshot

field.name: snapshotTimestamp
field.description: Cluster timestamp when snapshot was taken

field.name: storeCount
field.description: Number of *Snapshot messages following this header

field.name: totalByteLength
field.description: Total bytes of all subsequent snapshot messages (for sizing the loader buffer)

field.name: checksum
field.description: CRC32C of all subsequent snapshot bytes (corruption detection)

sbe:message.name: AccountSnapshot
sbe:message.description: Repeating group of full account records, used to restore AccountStore on cluster recovery. Records are ordered by accountId.

group.name: noAccounts
group.description: One entry per account in the AccountStore

sbe:message.name: OrderBookSnapshot
sbe:message.description: Repeating group of active (non-terminal) orders, used to restore OrderBook on cluster recovery. Filled/Canceled/Rejected orders are not snapshotted; the OrderBook reconstructs terminal state by replaying events.

group.name: noOrders
group.description: One entry per active order (FIX NoOrders)

field.name: ordType
field.description: Limit/Market/etc. Required so the matching engine can correctly age restored orders.

field.name: timeInForce
field.description: Day/GTC/IOC/FOK. Required so restored orders honour their original TIF semantics.

field.name: price
field.description: Limit price, fixed-point 10^-8. Optional — null for Market orders.

sbe:message.name: RfqStateSnapshot
sbe:message.description: Non-terminal RFQs from the RfqStateMachine + recentlyTerminal LRU ring contents. After restore the state machine immediately expires any RFQ whose TTL has elapsed relative to the recovery cluster timestamp.

field.name: recentlyTerminalRingHead
field.description: LRU ring head index — pointer to the next insertion slot. Persisted so a recovered node reconstructs the FIFO eviction order exactly as the leader had it at snapshot time.

group.name: noRfqs
group.description: One entry per non-terminal RFQ

field.name: quoteId
field.description: Set when state ≥ Quoted; empty otherwise

field.name: bidPx
field.description: Bid price (set when state ≥ Quoted), fixed-point 10^-8

field.name: offerPx
field.description: Offer price (set when state ≥ Quoted), fixed-point 10^-8

field.name: bidSize
field.description: Bid quantity (set when state ≥ Quoted), fixed-point 10^-8

field.name: offerSize
field.description: Offer quantity (set when state ≥ Quoted), fixed-point 10^-8

field.name: lastPx
field.description: Locked-in price when the client accepted (single-leg Accepted state), fixed-point 10^-8

field.name: swapPoints
field.description: Custom: far price - near price for swap RFQs, fixed-point 10^-8

field.name: validUntil
field.description: ValidUntilTime for the quote, epoch nanos

field.name: settlCurrency
field.description: ISO 4217 settlement currency (differs from currency for NDFs). Empty bytes = same as currency.

group.name: noLegs
group.description: Per-leg state for swap RFQs (empty for single-leg). Carries QuoteRequest-style leg identity AND the per-leg prices/sizes that the RfqStateMachine holds for Quoted/Accepted states — so a swap RFQ mid-flight can be fully restored across cluster recovery.

field.name: legPrice
field.description: Validated leg price in Accepted state (FIX LegPrice), fixed-point 10^-8

field.name: legBidPx
field.description: Leg bid price sent to client in Quoted state, fixed-point 10^-8

field.name: legOfferPx
field.description: Leg offer price sent to client in Quoted state, fixed-point 10^-8

field.name: legBidSize
field.description: Leg bid size in Quoted state, fixed-point 10^-8

field.name: legOfferSize
field.description: Leg offer size in Quoted state, fixed-point 10^-8

group.name: noRecentlyTerminal
group.description: Recently-terminal quoteReqIds + ring slot + reason byte for cross-replica dedup determinism

sbe:message.name: PositionSnapshot
sbe:message.description: Repeating group of net positions used to restore the cluster PositionTracker on recovery. Positions are keyed by (accountId, symbol) — one entry per unique pair with a non-zero position.

group.name: noPositions
group.description: One entry per (account, symbol) with a non-zero position

field.name: realizedPnl
field.description: Realized P&L for the day, fixed-point 10^-8

sbe:message.name: IdGeneratorSnapshot
sbe:message.description: Repeating group of IdGenerator counter values keyed by prefix (e.g., 'ORD', 'EXE', 'QTE'). Required for deterministic ID assignment after recovery.

group.name: noGenerators
group.description: One entry per IdGenerator instance

field.name: counter
field.description: Current counter value (next assigned id = counter + 1)

sbe:message.name: EventSequencerSnapshot
sbe:message.description: EventSequencer state — the next sequence number to assign after recovery. Single-record (no group) since there is exactly one EventSequencer per cluster.

field.name: nextSequence
field.description: Next event sequence number to assign

sbe:message.name: ClOrdIdDedupSnapshot
sbe:message.description: Cluster-side ClOrdID dedup registry snapshot — header (lastEvictionTimestampNanos + tradingHalted flag) plus a repeating group of (dedupKey, firstSeenTimestampNanos). dedupKey is the 64-bit FNV-1a hash of (sessionId bytes || clOrdId bytes), the same key used at admission time in NewOrderSingleHandler. Restoring this fragment is essential for 24h ClOrdID-uniqueness enforcement across cluster restarts. The tradingHalted flag rides this template (rather than a dedicated snapshot template) because both fields share a single cluster-state owner (NewOrderSingleHandler's enclosing TradingState) and a new template would require a SNAPSHOT_STORE_COUNT bump plus full encode/restore wiring for a single byte.

field.name: lastEvictionTimestampNanos
field.description: Throttle anchor for the next O(N) eviction sweep — restored verbatim so the post-snapshot eviction cadence matches pre-snapshot behaviour.

field.name: tradingHalted
field.description: Persisted cluster-wide trading-halt flag from TradingState. 1 = halted (NewOrderSingleHandler rejects every NOS with RejectReasonEnum.TradingHalted at Check 0); 0 = admitting. Snapshot persistence ensures an operator-set halt survives cluster restart (Aeron failover, planned restart) — a halt that lifted on restore would be a safety-critical audit gap.

group.name: noEntries
group.description: Live registry entries. Iteration order is not stable across runs (Agrona Long2LongHashMap rehashing) but order does not affect correctness since restore writes into a fresh map by key.

field.name: dedupKey
field.description: FNV-1a 64-bit hash of (Aeron sessionId 8 bytes little-endian || clOrdId trimmed bytes). Matches the key computed in NewOrderSingleHandler at admission time.

field.name: firstSeenTimestamp
field.description: Cluster timestamp (epoch nanos) at which the dedupKey was first observed. Compared against CLORDID_DEDUP_WINDOW_NS at restore time.

sbe:message.name: CurrencySnapshot
sbe:message.description: Repeating group of full ISO 4217 currency records, used to restore CurrencyStore on cluster recovery. Records are ordered by ccyCode (lex ASCII) for deterministic snapshot output.

sbe:message.name: RiskLimitSnapshot
sbe:message.description: Repeating group of full risk-limit records, used to restore RiskLimitStore on cluster recovery. Records are ordered by accountId for deterministic snapshot output.
